violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: open package box of tofu on a self below a bowl filled with marinated raw chicken.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM WAS INFORMED TO RELOCATED TOFU TO SHELF ABOVE RAW MEAT OR TO THE VEGGIE SIDE OF THE WIC.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: all working containers of ingredients on the spice cart in front of wok station.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. EHS observed roaches on the gasket of the home style fridge once it was open and on the side of the refrigerated prep unit across from fryers.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: filters in hood system, exterior of all bulk containers (rice, sugar, etc.), sides of fryers and flattop grill, exterior of the chicken marinade machine.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the floor sinks throughout are in need of cleaning in addition to mop sink area and water heater.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. BEIJING TOKYO ASIAN BISTRO (Inspection Date: 07/21/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: EHS did not observe staff who arrived later during the inspection wash their hands upon entering the kitchen from the rear door.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at the handwashing sink near the rear door.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: foods sitting on top of the inside of the refrigerated prep unit: chicken 45°F, dumpling 45°F, egg roll 45°F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. DISCARDED.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: The EHS provided the vomit and diarrhea clean up procedures to the CFM for guidance and compliance. BEIJING TOKYO ASIAN BISTRO (Inspection Date: 03/25/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: crab Rangoon , egg rolls, sweet and sour chicken in the walk in cooler, prep top coolers and the upright cooler.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM marked the food items with dates during the inspection for compliance.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: multiple containers and bottles of hoisin sauce, soy sauce, salt, pepper, sugar, miso powder, chicken base powder, oils, vinegar, water, corn starch at the cookline.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM labeled the food items with the common names for proper identification.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: There were containers of meat being stored directly on the floor in the walk in freezer.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM will need to relocate the meat from the floor to the shelving unit for proper storage.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM was instructed to make buckets of sanitizer to store in-use wet wiping cloths.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: the ice scoop handle was stored inside of the ice.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM removed the ice scoop and stored it with the handle above the level of the ice.
